title: Mr. Frog Becomes President
description: The nation's most famous amphibian runs for the highest office. The scandal trades easy — the forgiveness is where the money is.

companies.name: The Frog Network
companies.description: Airs one program: a 40-season amphibian variety show. Ad-funded; no other hits; the backup schedule is a fireplace.

companies.name: Smiling Friends Inc.
companies.description: Two-man cheer-up charity paid per smile; takes any client, however hopeless. One office, one intern, no second location.

companies.name: Frowning Friends Corp.
companies.description: Corporate misery-management giant; sells attack ads, layoff announcements and bad news delivered in gray suits.

companies.name: The Daily Gawk
companies.description: Celebrity tabloid; circulation doubles on scandal and halves on forgiveness. Photographers famous for getting too close.

companies.name: Goodstead Casualty
companies.description: Underwrites live-broadcast liability, including every presidential debate; premiums tiny, payouts biblical.

companies.name: TallyRight Systems
companies.description: Builds and services every voting machine in the country; paid per ballot counted, recounts billed at double rate.

companies.name: Pockets & Pals Toys
companies.description: Plush-toy maker; pays steep royalties for exclusive likeness rights to whatever face the nation loves this year.

companies.name: Gravitas News
companies.description: Cable news channel of record; its chief anchor Ted Baxley moderates every presidential debate by tradition.

companies.name: Bulwark Coachworks
companies.description: Hand-builds armored state limousines; every incoming administration orders a custom fleet. Also does amphibious hulls.

companies.name: Spit Records
companies.description: Label and touring arm of the world's loudest DJ; owns his catalog, his residency, and one very large speaker.

companies.name: Salty's Pizza
companies.description: Nine hundred boardwalk pizza stands; the founder was violently murdered years ago, case open, recipe in escrow.

companies.name: Bliblie Springs Water
companies.description: Bottles spring water from a valley of small yellow creatures; the creatures are unbothered and feature on the label.
